text:
samir: Heads-up — Seneca just dropped a customer adapter (v0.4) and a small eval pack. I merged it onto transformer-xl-3b on staging with our int4 profile and I'm seeing a big NER drop. Can someone run the full eval pack and skim for regression patterns? Link: https://redir/seneca/lora-v0.4.zip

alana: On it. quick Q — did you use the int4-std quant profile or the compat fallback?

samir: int4-std. merge command I used: ```python merge_lora.py --base transformer-xl-3b --adapter seneca_v0.4 --out merged/seneca-merged --quant int4-std```

priya: If the drop is NER-specific, could be KV-cache alignment with adapter attention heads. Can you dump attention maps + logits for a few failures?

samir: pushed a small trace to /tmp/seneca-trace.tar.gz on staging-host-3. Example failing prompt: "Find the dates and organizations in this email" — the merged model drops the organization slot.

mike: I can run the suite. Which eval set to start with — seneca_named_entities or full-cust-bench?

samir: start with seneca_ner_2026 (10k). If it still fails, run full-cust-bench. Eval command: ```./run_eval.sh --model merged/seneca-merged --quant int4 --suite seneca_ner_2026 --save results/seneca-ner.json```

eval-bot: queued job 6381 for user mike — started at 1968000345

mike: job 6381 logs: a few warnings about "padding mismatch" during batching. I'll retry with --pad-mode=left.

alana: Also try disabling KV cache fusion: set KV_FUSION=false in the runtime env. We've seen int4 + adapter failure patterns before.

priya: If disabling fusion helps, we should capture a minimal repro. Also double-check tokenization — Seneca mentioned an "aggressive-split" patch in their README.

samir: I applied tokenize_patch.txt before merging, so tokenization should match. Trace and notes at /tmp and linked in the PR.

mike: Results: seneca_ner_2026 -> F1 dropped from baseline 0.87 to 0.61 on merged-int4. With KV_FUSION=false it recovers to 0.84. Artifacts: results/seneca-ner.json, logs/seneca-kv-off.log

jen: Nice find. Can we run a small canary on Dedicated with KV_FUSION=false + int8 to measure perf/price impact before we talk to the customer?

alana: Perf note — turning off fusion adds ~35ms p99 for 3b on our clusters. If Seneca's SLA tolerates it, rolling with KV_FUSION=false might be the fastest path. Otherwise we can look at adapter re-compilation to be fusion-safe.

priya: I'll run a sensitivity sweep: int4-std vs int4-stable vs int8 across 3 seeds to map accuracy vs cost. Scheduling grid for tonight.

samir: Action items: 1) mike to run full-cust-bench with KV_FUSION=false for int4 & int8; 2) priya to run sensitivity grid; 3) alana to prepare customer-facing notes on tradeoffs; 4) draft rollback plan if we ship the merged adapter. @mike @priya @alana please ack.

mike: :thumbsup:

alana: ack

priya: ack — starting grid now

eval-bot: job 6381 completed at 1968000560 — results attached: results/seneca-ner.json (S3: s3://redwood-staging/seneca/results/6381.json)

samir: I'll draft a short summary for Seneca and propose options: A) deploy merged-int4 with KV_FUSION=false; B) use int8 for production to avoid disabling fusion; C) ask Seneca to re-export adapter with head-alignment patch. Thoughts?

jen: Present options + perf/price delta. I can help write the wording for PM and customer success.

samir: ty — will drop draft in #customer-success after lunch.
